descriptor: Natural-fibre clothing made in small runs

voice.summary: Linen & Loom writes like a quiet fashion editor: short lines, seasonal and sensory, with an eye on fabric rather than trend. It lets colour names and fibres carry the mood.
dos: Name fibres and dye colours exactly
Describe each look in one calm sentence
Use season words sparingly and honestly
donts: Do not use hype words like iconic or must-have
Never claim sustainability without a fact

taglines: Cut to last past the season
Dressed in what the field gave
boilerplate: Linen & Loom is a clothing label making undyed and naturally dyed pieces in linen, wool and cotton, cut to last well beyond a single season.
